Thanks Dana — great to get this started. Quick answers inline below and a couple of attachments that should help speed procurement on your side.

On Wed, Mar 28, 2028 at 9:12 AM Dana Park <dana@helio-systems.com> wrote:
> - Do you require a signed SOW for initial PO issuance, or can we start with a blanket PO referencing the SOW to follow?

You can submit a blanket PO that references the SOW if your internal process prefers that. We do require the following at a minimum before we accept and route for payment: vendor legal name, tax ID/EIN (if US), billing address, and a PO number. If you plan to use a blanket PO, include a not-to-exceed amount and reference the SOW version/date.

> - Preferred PO line-item structure (total vs. itemized units, SKU vs. service line, tax handling) — can you share a recommended template?

Attached is our recommended PO_lineitem_template.csv — it shows the four fields we map to our billing system: line_description, quantity, unit_price, account_code. For software/managed services we prefer itemized rows by feature or seat type, not a single total lump sum (this helps with billing reconciliation). Tax should be a separate line at the end.

> - Expected lead time between Redwood sign-off and PO issuance from our finance team (we budget for 7-10 business days typically).

We typically see POs come through within 5-12 business days depending on customer procurement. If you provide the onboarding form fully populated, it usually speeds things into the 5-7 day range.

> - Any mandatory fields on your vendor onboarding form we should pre-populate to speed vendor setup?

I've attached our vendor onboarding form filled with the fields that create the fastest path: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf. Key fields: bank ACH details OR remit address, tax_id, primary billing contact (email/phone), support contact, and preferred invoice frequency.

Next steps: please return the signed SOW (or DocuSign link), confirm PO template usage, and we'll schedule the kickoff sync. Either of the times you proposed work for us — Logan will take Mon Apr 2 10am PT.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Sr. Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf; PO_lineitem_template.csv

Looping in the procurement playbook items so finance and the Helio team have a clear SOW -> PO path. Feel free to forward this to your finance contact, Dana.

1) PO Requirement confirmation (what we need from Helio before we accept a PO):
   - Legal vendor name (exact match to W9)
   - Tax ID / EIN (or WHT documentation for non-US entities)
   - Billing remit address or ACH details (bank account + routing)
   - Purchase order number and referenced SOW version/date
   - Primary invoice recipient email and contact number

2) Recommended PO issuance timeline (for Helio expectations):
   - DocuSign executed: Day 0
   - Redwood internal billing/vendor setup: Days 0-2 (assuming onboarding form complete)
   - Finance review & PO issuance from customer side: Days 3-10 (depends on customer approval cadence)
   - First invoice processed by Redwood: within 5 business days of receiving PO and completed vendor setup

3) Line-item structure guidance (to avoid reconciliation delays):
   - Use granular lines when there are multiple fee types (e.g., base subscription, overage, professional services).
   - Each line should include: description, units (or seats), unit price, period (e.g., monthly/annual), and accounting code if available.
   - Include a separate line for taxes/fees and one final "Total (not tax)" line to aid matching.
   - If you must send a single lump-sum line, include an attached Excel (or CSV) that breaks the total into the same granular rows we expect.

4) Attachments & references we expect with initial PO submission:
   - Completed vendor onboarding form (PDF)
   - Executed SOW (PDF or DocuSign link)
   - PO_lineitem_template.csv (if you used it to construct the PO)

5) Kickoff logistics: Logan, can you send the calendar invite for Mon Apr 2 10am PT and include the drive folder with the onboarding artifacts? Dana — please invite your finance lead so we can resolve any account-code questions live.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference
